candidates.title: State of Delaware Tax Preference Report - 2017
candidates.description: Delaware's biennial report assessing the impact of tax preferences on the personal income tax, corporate income tax, motor fuel/special fuel tax, and public utility tax. This report is published biennially in the December timeframe.

candidates.title: Opportunity Zones
candidates.description: Opportunity Zones are a new community development program established by Congress as a part of the Tax Cuts and Jobs Act of 2017, they are designed to encourage long-term private investments in low-income communities. This program provides a federal tax incentive for taxpayers who reinvest unrealized capital gains into "Opportunity Funds," which are specialized vehicles dedicated to investing in low-income areas called "Opportunity Zones."The zones themselves are to be comprised of low-income community census tracts and designated by governors in every state. South Carolina designated 25 percent of qualifying census tracts as an Opportunity Zone. Qualifying Zones are based on the 2011-2015 American Community Survey.
